Capital Markets Technology is seeking a strong MS .Net (C\#) trading system Engineer to develop system automations and enterprise solutions for Equity/Options trading infrastructures, and maintain and improve the existing infrastructure.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer in the Benelux Geo team, you will lead technical engagements for high-growth potential customers, owning discovery, solution design, and platform demonstrations. We are looking for a talented engineer/architect who is excited to expand strategic partnerships and grow Databricks footprint with these customers!

The Impact You Will Have

Independently lead technical discovery and solution design for customer workloads spanning Data Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, and GenAI Engineering
Build and deliver compelling proofs-of-concept and live demos on the Databricks Platform that drive technical wins
Own frontline technical relationships with customer engineers, data teams, and technical leads
Develop account-level technical strategies in partnership with your Account Executive to grow platform consumption
Navigate competitive landscapes by articulating Databricks differentiation through hands-on demonstrations
Contribute reusable technical assets (notebooks, solution accelerators, reference architectures) to the broader SA community

Industry experience in data engineering, solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or a hands-on consulting role (preference for 3+ years minimum)

Experience leading technical customer conversations — discovery, whiteboarding, architecture reviews

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle
sind bei uns selbstverständlich – du kannst gerne von zu Hause arbeiten und gleichzeitig freuen wir uns, dich an unseren Teamtagen (Di. und Do.) im Büro in Freiburg im Breisgau
begrüßen zu dürfen.

Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Du hast die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten. Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Anforderungen vorgegeben werden, stattdessen hilfst du, sie gemeinsam zu definieren. In Discovery-Phasen, Delivery-Momenten und den Etappenzielen dazwischen ist deine Seniorität gefragt
Tech-Stack & Architektur: Du arbeitest in einer modernen Microservice-Architektur und stellst die reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen den Services sicher. Mit deinem Team entscheidest du über den Einsatz neuer Tools und Ansätze, die es braucht, damit Skalierung tatsächlich möglich wird.
Agentic AI & Future Work: Wir begreifen KI nicht nur als Werkzeug, sondern als Motor für einen fundamentalen Wachstumsschritt. Du gestaltest diesen Wandel aktiv mit und hilfst uns, KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows tief in unsere Produktstrukturen zu integrieren. Übrigen gibt es bei uns den frAIday. Was dahinter steckt, erzählen wir dir gerne persönlich. Interesse geweckt?

Das Bringst Du Mit

Full Stack@Heart: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bau moderner Backend-Systeme mit Spring Boot und Java. Erfahrung mit React, TypeScript und Material UI runden dein breit aufgebautes Profil ab
Daten, Cloud & AI: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in relationalen Datenbanken (vorzugsweise PostgreSQL) mit und bewegst dich sicher in der AWS-Welt. Deine Erfahrungen im Datenbankdesign und den damit notwendigen Optimierungen oder Migrationen, nimmst du als spannende Projekte wahr. Idealerweise bist du bereits mit AI-Native Engineering vertraut und kannst auf Erfahrungen zurückblicken
Brücken bauen: Für diese Position suchen wir bewusst eine sehr erfahrene Persönlichkeit mit hoher Kommunikationskompetenz: Dir gelingt es, die Brücken zwischen Entwicklung, Produkt, UX und weiteren Disziplinen zu schlagen und ein gewinnbringendes Zusammenspiel zu fördern
Kommunikation: Unsere Teamsprache ist Deutsch, daher sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C2) ein Muss

Bei uns trifft der jüngste Podcast-Tipp in der Kaffeeküche auf den nächsten Pass auf dem Platz. jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you’ll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, You’ll

Work with a cross-functional team. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features.
Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you’ll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
Mentor. You’ll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
User-focused. You’re excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

The Opportunity

Today, EF English Live does not consistently apply appropriate QA coverage to relevant Salesforce and Web tickets before release. Volume has outpaced our current QA capacity, so coverage gaps happen, and where testing does happen it often leans towards happy-path checks rather than risk-based regression testing. We already use AIO for automation and want to build on it further, and more hands are needed to close the coverage gap in the meantime.

This role is about adding real capacity: hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, with risk-based coverage applied according to the nature and impact of each change, plus active support extending and complementing our existing AIO automation. Our existing QA lead will continue to own and drive the automation strategy; this hire works alongside them, splitting time between hands-on testing and helping extend that automation over time.

Role Overview

This is a fixed-term contract engagement, initially for 4 to 6 months. The Senior QA Automation Engineer will provide thorough, hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based coverage according to the nature and impact of each change, while also helping extend and complement our existing AIO automation. This is a genuinely hybrid role: meaningful hands-on testing capacity now, and a growing share of automation work over time , done in close partnership with our existing QA lead rather than in place of them.

Within 3 Months, Success Looks Like

All relevant Salesforce and Web tickets receiving appropriate QA coverage before release, with risk-based testing applied according to the nature and impact of the change.
Regression testing meaningfully expanded beyond happy-path checks.
Our existing AIO automation extended and complemented, with additional tooling or approaches identified where they would provide better coverage or maintainability.
The existing QA lead measurably better supported, with more capacity across the team rather than the load resting on one person.

Main Responsibilities

Hands-On QA Coverage (Salesforce & Web)

Provide thorough manual and exploratory testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based testing according to the nature and impact of each change.
Prioritise regression testing, not just happy-path checks, to reduce the risk of shipping undetected issues.

Test Automation & Tooling

Extend and complement our existing AIO automation, identifying where additional tooling or approaches would provide better coverage or maintainability.
Work alongside the existing QA lead, who owns the overall automation strategy and roadmap, contributing hands-on automation build where needed.

Collaboration & Capability Building

Work alongside the existing QA lead and engineering team to raise the overall QA bar, across both tooling and process.
Partner with Business Systems and engineering leads to prioritise coverage based on commercial risk.

Reporting

Report to Business Systems Engineering leadership, with visibility on release risk and quality metrics shared with the wider team.

Technical Background & Skills

Core Experience

Strong hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience across web applications and, ideally, CRM/Salesforce environments.
Experience in automating tests using Javascript /Typescript frameworks (e.g. Nightwatch.js, Cypress, Playwright)
Experience with API and integration testing, including validating data flows between Salesforce, web applications and third-party systems.
Comfortable splitting time between hands-on ticket testing and automation work, rather than being purely one or the other.

Ways of Working

Genuinely hybrid: as comfortable manually testing a ticket as contributing to an automation framework.
Collaborative: complements and supports the existing QA lead's automation strategy rather than working around it.
Pragmatic about what to automate first, while making sure day-to-day coverage across Salesforce and Web doesn't slip in the meantime.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product and on capabilities used by investment professionals to understand portfolios, performance and risk.

In your daily work you will, together with your team, understand and review customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, Dyalog APL and Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend components, APIs and services.

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping parts of our product for the cloud. We are not modernizing for the sake of fashion. We are doing it because our products are business critical, widely used and need to keep evolving in a careful way.

AI Is Part Of How We Work Every Day

We use AI every day and see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. We actively look for ways to integrate AI into our work whenever it creates real benefit for our customers, products, teams or engineers. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work, explore alternatives and build better software.

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team and individual.

We encourage personal development, curiosity and experimentation. Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements, giving you regular opportunities to explore new technologies, improve something important, or try out ideas that may benefit you, your team or the application.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We are looking for a developer who enjoys real product engineering: understanding the problem, discussing trade-offs, writing good software, ensuring quality and improving the system over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to help lead beyond writing code. You will contribute to design discussions, help the team make good technical decisions, improve maintainability and performance, and support the software you help build.

Designing, developing and maintaining backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET
Working with Dyalog APL and other technologies where they are part of the product
Contributing to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value
Improving performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience
Using CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work
Using AI every day as part of practical engineering work, including exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, generating prototypes, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks
Working with the team to discover where AI can create real value in our development process and where human engineering judgment should lead
Collaborating with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software solutions
Supporting the team in continuously improving both the product and the way we work

What We Expect From You

We expect you to know some of the following and be able to, and interested in, learning the rest:

C# and .NET development
Backend development and API design
Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications
Continuous integration and delivery
Automated testing and practical quality engineering
Working with relational databases, such as Oracle or similar
Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services
A willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL
Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and how it can improve daily development work

Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important than your ability to learn, collaborate, and handle responsibilities.

We value people who are good at several of the following and interested in improving the rest:

Leading your work and achieving results
Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
Working with others to leverage the abilities of everyone in the team
Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
Looking continuously for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Comparing technical quality with business value
Using modern tools, especially AI tools, every day where they help us build better software and become better engineers
Contributing to an inclusive, trust-based and collaborative engineering culture

How We Work

We believe good software engineering is a team activity. Quality is not something handed over at the end. It is built into the way we discuss requirements, design solutions, write code, test, review, deploy and learn from production feedback.

We also believe senior engineers should have room to think. We do not expect you to chase every trend. We expect you to apply sound engineering judgment, use modern practices where they help, and help us evolve a large and widely used product in a way that is sustainable for clients, users and engineers.
